h2: Pool Repair Jimbaran – Leaks, Tiles & Pipework
intro: If your villa pool near the bay or up the Bukit is losing water, shedding tiles, or weeping at the joints, Pool Repair Jimbaran is where I come in. I work across Kedonganan, Goa Gong and Bukit Jimbaran, diagnosing the real fault before recommending any fix.

sections.h3: How Jimbaran's Conditions Stress Your Pool
sections.text: Jimbaran sits where the Bukit meets the bay, so a villa in Kedonganan deals with salt-laden air while one up in Goa Gong battles low tank pressure and pump cycling. Hard water from the local supply coats heaters, mixers and pool equipment with limescale within months. Both problems accelerate wear on fittings, seals and pipework — the exact components that fail when your pool starts losing water or tiles pop loose.

sections.h3: Typical Pool Repair Jobs in Jimbaran
sections.text: Most pools around here are fifteen to twenty years old, so I usually see a combination of issues rather than one clean fault. A family villa in Bukit Jimbaran might have cracked mosaic along the step, weeping pipe joints behind the skimmer, and grout that has crumbled from constant chlorine exposure. Before touching anything, I'll walk through what's urgent versus what can wait, so you're not paying for a full re-tile when a targeted leak repair will hold.

A short video of the problem area plus two or three close-up photos is all I need to start assessing. If water is disappearing, note how much over twenty-four hours and whether the level drops even with the pump off. For tile or grout work, a photo showing the affected stretch helps me gauge scope. Once I've reviewed your messages, I'll come back with a quote — cost depends entirely on what's underneath, so there's no fixed rate until I see the job.

Salt air near Jimbaran Bay eats through stainless fittings and pump housings faster than inland, so a quick wipe-down after heavy humidity days extends their life. If your villa sits up the Bukit, check tank levels weekly; pumps that cycle constantly wear seals and trip breakers. Descale your heater and mixer every few months to stop limescale from choking flow. Small maintenance now saves a full equipment swap later.

faq.q: Do you cover villas in Goa Gong and Kelan as well?
faq.a: Yes — I travel across all of Jimbaran including Jimbaran Bay, Kedonganan, Bukit Jimbaran, Goa Gong and Kelan. Just send photos on WhatsApp and I'll confirm access before scheduling.

faq.q: How do I get a price without booking a visit first?
faq.a: Message me on WhatsApp with a short video and a couple of close-up shots of the issue. I review them and reply with a quote based on what the job actually involves.

faq.q: My pool has several problems at once — do I have to fix everything at once?
faq.a: Not necessarily. I'll prioritise anything that's actively leaking or structurally unsound, then we can schedule cosmetic work like re-grouting or tile replacement for a later date that suits your budget.
